REQ-048.design_rationale: Section 1.1 specifies the vendoring directory layout under scripts/review/rules/ (including LICENSE.apache-2.0.txt, system_rules.json, and 57 rule_docs/*.md files), and Section 2 specifies test verification for AC-048-1 verifying all 47 path_rule_map globs and 57 rule docs load cleanly.

REQ-048.debate_rationale: ADR-010 documents evaluated trade-offs (offline zero-dependency execution vs. periodic sync overhead) and explicitly rejected alternatives (shelling out to ocr delegate rule CLI and creating an isolated standalone plugin) without imposing arbitrary line caps.
REQ-048.evidence_rationale: verification.md confirms test_req_048_vendored_rule_corpus passed, verifying system_rules.json and all 57 rule_docs/*.md files exist and are non-empty.

REQ-049.debate_rationale: ADR-010 weighs native standard library implementation against external CLI delegation, rejecting ocr delegate rule due to npm lifecycle dependencies and the risk of un-bypassable test file exclusion violating TDD invariants.

REQ-050.design_rationale: Section 1.3 defines the prompt injection integration for scripts/review/prompts.py, adding Ground A (Diff Scope Invariant), Ground B (No Literal Diff Contradiction), protected categories, and <language_review_rules> strictly when mode == 'code', while Section 2 defines test verification for AC-050-1 and AC-050-2.
REQ-050.tasks_rationale: Task 3 specifies the exact prompt modification in scripts/review/prompts.py for --mode code, and Task 4 defines regression test assertions ensuring mode == 'code' receives the guardrails while spec and design modes remain unaffected.
REQ-050.debate_rationale: ADR-011 weighs single-pass prompt injection against a two-pass LLM review filter pipeline, rejecting a secondary review pass due to high cumulative model invocation latency (15-45s) across WorkBuddy and Argon adapters.
REQ-050.evidence_rationale: verification.md confirms test_req_050_code_mode_prompt_injection passed, verifying code-review prompt injects <language_review_rules> and Ground A/B guardrails while spec/design modes remain unaffected.
